name: Kodikkarai Sanctuary Wayside Tea Stalls
signature_dish: Tea and basic snacks at the sanctuary-village stalls
why_it_matters: Point Calimere (Kodikkarai) Wildlife Sanctuary has no restaurant — only a couple of small wayside eateries with a minimal menu and tea stalls near the entrance in Kodiakkarai village. Visitor guides advise vegetarians to arrange food from Vedaranyam and note that local hotels will cook chicken or mutton only if you bring it from the shops.
insider_tip: Treat this as honest scarcity — carry your own food or eat in Vedaranyam (~10km) before the visit. The village stalls are fine for tea while watching the flamingos and blackbuck, not for a meal. Small cash only.
signature_address: Kodiakkarai village, near Point Calimere Wildlife Sanctuary, Nagapattinam District, Tamil Nadu 614810

name: Kodiakkarai Village Seafood Mess
signature_dish: Fresh local seafood — fish curry and fry, what the day's catch allows
why_it_matters: In the fishing village of Kodiakkarai, the small mess kitchens serve only seafood — local fish curry and fry built on the day's catch. Visitor guides confirm that at Point Calimere non-vegetarians get food from a village mess and that only seafood is reliably available; vegetarians must arrange meals from Vedaranyam.
insider_tip: This is a fishing village, so seafood is the realistic order and availability follows the catch — ask in the morning. If you want vegetarian food, eat in Vedaranyam instead. Small cash only.
signature_address: Kodiakkarai village, near Point Calimere, Nagapattinam District, Tamil Nadu 614810

name: Veda Mess, Vedaranyam
area: East Main Street, near bus stand, Vedaranyam (gateway ~10km)
signature_dish: South Indian vegetarian meals served on a banana leaf
why_it_matters: Described on TripAdvisor as the only pure-vegetarian restaurant in Vedaranyam — Veda Mess on East Main Street near the bus stand serves cheap, well-regarded South Indian meals on banana leaves. With Point Calimere itself having no vegetarian dining, this is the realistic veg meal stop for sanctuary visitors.
insider_tip: If you are vegetarian and visiting Point Calimere, plan a meal here in Vedaranyam on the way in or out — the sanctuary village has only seafood. Banana-leaf meals at lunch are the order. Small cash; UPI may work.
signature_address: East Main Street, near bus stand, Vedaranyam, Nagapattinam District, Tamil Nadu 614810

name: Aananthaa AC Restaurant, Vedaranyam
area: East Main Street, North Madavilagam, near bus stand, Vedaranyam (gateway ~10km)
signature_dish: South Indian lunch meals with fish fry and curries
why_it_matters: An air-conditioned restaurant near the Vedaranyam bus stand serving both vegetarian and non-vegetarian South Indian food — Aananthaa is the most-reviewed everyday eatery in Vedaranyam, the gateway town for Point Calimere about 10km away. It is the practical full-meal stop, with a South Indian lunch that includes fish fry and curries.
insider_tip: The realistic non-veg or mixed meal option near Point Calimere — eat here in Vedaranyam since the sanctuary village only has basic seafood messes. Air conditioning is a relief in this hot coastal belt. Cash + UPI.
